normalization: EPR estimates and differences are divided by the uncoupled pair EPR.
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% Student intervals across independent oscillator pairs. The two EPR estimators share paths and their difference is paired. Refinement changes are refined minus baseline, with Welch intervals for independent runs. The depth from the uncoupled estimate also uses a Welch interval. Replica-count estimates use nested subsets. Radial variance uses a replica jackknife.

sampled_minimizers.method: Bootstrap minimizers over the sampled coupling grid.
